description: This file contains Redux reducers for managing user preferences in the Mattermost application, including functions to handle preferences state updates and combining reducers.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a preference based on its category and name.

methods.name: setAllPreferences
methods.description: Creates a new preferences state object from an array of preferences.

methods.name: setAllUserPreferences
methods.description: Creates a user-specific preferences state object from an array of preferences.

methods.name: myPreferences
methods.description: Reducer function to handle the current user's preferences state based on actions.

methods.name: userPreferences
methods.description: Reducer function to handle other users' preferences state based on actions.
